title: Criteria/matrix mismatch
text: Criteria/matrix mismatch: AC19 requires every enabled pass with an unreadable, empty, or malformed list to record that the sweep did not run, while AC1 explicitly requires pre-review skips to emit no sweep metadata. Scope AC19 and the corresponding business rule to passes that reach review execution, or define the intended precedence, so draft/existing-check skips have one testable outcome.
